Andre Norton, Star Born.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/andre-norton/star-born

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Andre Norton, the author, died 2005.

First publication of the text used: 1957, in Cleveland, Ohio, United States (SE colophon: 'Star Born was published in 1957 by Andre Norton'; Wikipedia, 'Star Born': 'first published in 1957 by World Publishing Company of Cleveland').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1957 in the United States. The edition's own statement of rights says the text is in the United States public domain, and the country of origin is also the United States, so that statement covers both sides.
- Country of origin (United States): see above. No other country is named as a place of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights:
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published in 1957 by Andre Norton
- Wikipedia, 'Star Born': first published in 1957 by World Publishing Company of Cleveland
